hawaii.title: Hawaiʻi
hawaii.description: Ka Pae ʻĀina ʻo Hawaiʻi — Honolulu, Hilo, Kahului; Oʻahu, Maui, Hawaiʻi (ka Mokupuni Nui), Kauaʻi, Molokaʻi a me Lānaʻi; Mauna Kea, Mauna Loa, Haleakalā, Puʻuloa (Pearl Harbor) a me ke kahakai ʻo Nā Pali.

south-central-us.title: Ka Hema Waena o ʻAmelika Hui Pū ʻIa
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi a me Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson a me Birmingham.
